title: Caught
steps: You are almost there. The familiar way down to the warm dormitory is just ahead.
Suddenly, Dask steps right out of the dark. You are caught!
What are two first-year pupils doing out of bed at this hour?
We were just inspecting the floating stairs, sir! To make sure they do not float away completely!
Dask looks at you both for a long, quiet moment. Then, you see the smallest smile appear on his face.
I watched you. You looked before you stepped, you waited, and you lit the dark. Clever work. I will let you go, just this once, {wizard}.

Safe in bed at last, you think about how much you have grown tonight. Asking questions with expressions and choosing with `if` and `else` kept you safe from Dask. A `for` loop easily climbed the stairs, and a `while` made you wait patiently in the shadows. As you remember casting the *kirra* and *osto* spells, a warm feeling of finally belonging to Arvelia washes over you, and you drift happily to sleep.
